a.lede: Data centers in Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, and Indonesia are now required to obtain export licenses if they want to get their Nvidia AI GPUs delivered.
a.title: Nvidia stops AI GPU shipments to Southeast Asia amid purported China cloud access ban, report claims

b.lede: Nvidia has told manufacturing partners to pause server shipments to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia as the U.S. tightens its push to keep AI chips out of China.
b.title: Nvidia hits pause on chip shipments to Southeast Asia
